visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt sits in a brightly lit indoor home setting, looking at an off-camera computer screen with a worried expression. A handheld gimbal camera is visible on the desk. (2) A screen recording shows a concert ticket booking interface for "SUPER JUNIOR" with a loading spinner. (3) The man reacts with shock and frustration, touching his face as blue loading icons overlay the frame. (4) The website displays a "Insufficient quantity" notification in a pop-up window. (5) The man yells in despair, leaning forward as large bold captions appear over his chest. (6) He stares blankly at the screen while spelling out a name, with rapid cuts between his face and the screen. (7) A close-up of his eyes shows a defeated look, with text bubbles "完" (Done) and "蛋" (Egg) appearing on either side. (8) He is seen pouring hot water from a metal kettle into a glass as a loading icon spins next to him. (9) He eats a snack vigorously with a dejected expression. (10) The screen recording reappears showing the loading spinner again. (11) He screams once more as the "Insufficient quantity" message returns.
